business.what_it_does: Company transmits bulk power, provides telecom services, and offers consultancy services in transmission, distribution, and telecom sectors.

segments.name: Transmission
segments.what: Transmits bulk power across different states of India.

segments.name: Consultancy
segments.what: Provides consultancy services in transmission, distribution, and telecom sectors.

segments.name: Telecom
segments.what: Leases point-to-point bandwidth using spare optical fibres.

business.mix_note: Revenue from any single customer does not equal or exceed 10% of total revenue.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Mar 2026 EBITDA margin plunged to 45.0% from 86.0% in Dec 2025 despite reported annual PAT growing 3%.
Free cash flow plummeted from Rs 12,111 crore in Mar 2025 to Rs 3,687 crore in Mar 2026 under heavy CapEx.
Gross fixed assets breached Rs 3.25 lakh crore in Q1 FY27 as total borrowings expanded to Rs 151,269 crore by Sep 2026.

bull: FY26 PAT reached Rs 15,928 crore while CapEx exceeded target at Rs 35,000+ crore.
Strong 5-year operating cash conversion standing at 225% of total reported net profit.
Transmission system availability maintained consistently at a high 99.8% level through Q1 FY27.
bear: Operating margin dropped 1500 bps over 3 years down to 70.0% in FY26.
Free cash flow collapsed by 69.5% to Rs 3,687 crore in FY26.
Total borrowings surged to Rs 151,269 crore as of September 2026.
watch: Progress towards FY27 capitalization guidance of Rs 30,000 crore.
EBITDA margin recovery from the Mar 2026 low of 45.0%.
